Both diagnostic modes use exactly the same binary; maintained foundation excludes diagnostic dispatch and candidate optimization.

interpretation.access_semantics: Stable access identifies immutable benchmark callbacks so production caches can be exercised. The conservative control preserves uncached callback semantics; this workload correction is not a production optimization.
interpretation.allocations: C++ allocations observed on the render thread; excludes profiler storage, malloc-only and other-thread allocations.
interpretation.cold: Setup and cold observations remain in raw reports and are not mixed into warm-frame statistics.
interpretation.frame_total: Wall time for offscreen frame work, including QRhi completion with --finish; not application FPS or CPU time.
interpretation.percent_change: 100 * (candidate / paired baseline - 1); negative means lower cost.
interpretation.replicate: One fresh process. No pooling of frames as independent replicates.
interpretation.scope_costs: Inclusive instrumented CPU-side scope wall times; nested scopes must not be added.
interpretation.spread: IQR and min/max describe process-to-process variation, not a confidence interval.
interpretation.submission: Includes begin/endOffscreenFrame and any backend synchronization they perform.
interpretation.validation: Timing runs exclude pixel readback. Validate pixels/semantics separately before accepting an optimization.

decision_rules: Retain all observations and failed invocations; no favorable-result retries.
If identical-binary variation is comparable to the effect, timing remains unresolved.
If no-text slowdown reproduces, inspect source-independent binary/layout effects and do one causally motivated follow-up.
Allocation and timing findings remain separate; native pixel/render tests required before promotion.
Do not repeat the full original campaign or rebuild unchanged dependencies without a concrete reason.
initial_plan.purpose: Continue PR30; assess reproducibility of conservative/no-text slowdown before promoting label optimization

publication.note: API-created commits have different identifiers; published Git tree IDs match the compiled local source trees exactly. Final report-only commits may follow the compiled foundation revision.

notes: All campaign manifests completed; frame observation counts match requested frames.
All workload-v3 reports contain no renderer scopes/observations or disabled internal preparation metrics.
Allocation minimum and maximum match for every workload-v3 measured process.
Duration percentiles on 50000-frame runs use the existing deterministic reservoir of 8192 retained samples; count, total, mean, minimum and maximum cover every observed frame.

campaigns.name: same-image-aa
campaigns.reason: Longer settled-text control because the original11microsecond same-binary control had substantial relative variation.

same_image_plan.purpose: Separate runtime label membership work from unrelated code placement in the two retained binaries
validation: Verify corrected harness source equality between foundation and diagnostic.
Both complete helper definitions must match original baseline/candidate exceptfunctionname; one identical executable path and hash for all modes.
Run maintainedCoreAlgo with both diagnostic modes before timings.
Require actual selected-mode marker for text, none for no-text.
Require all workload-v3 and phase checks; verify measured allocation min/max for settled cases.
Retain both unfavorable and favorable outcomes; no extra timing repetitions afterinspection.
Compare same-image stable effect against its own identical-mode control; no formal significance threshold.
If no-text keeps an appreciable penalty, stop and retain experiment as unresolved.
If no-text is near its control and label allocations fall, labelalgorithmalone is not necessary for originalpenalty; codeplacementremains hypothesis, not hardwareproof.
No productionpromotion or nativepixelclaim fromNull results.

same_image_source_validation.purpose: temporary same-executable causal diagnostic, not production code

selection.no_text: mode is not consulted; selected-algorithm marker must be absent
selection.read_boundary: first text helper call during warmup, once per process

scope.workload_versions: Retained binaries use historical v2; freshly built same-image diagnostics use corrected v3. Compare variants only within their campaign, never across workload contracts.
